content: 1. Huang S-C and Chun-Jen Liu C-J discuss the challenges and future perspectives of managing chronic hepatitis B in patients who also have metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease. Their study, published in Clinical and Molecular Hepatology in 2023, highlights the complexities of treating these overlapping conditions. 2. Huang Y, Gan Q, Lai R, Wang W, Guo S, Sheng Z, and colleagues explore the use of a fatty liver progression inhibition algorithm and the steatosis, activity, and fibrosis score to evaluate the impact of non-alcoholic fatty liver disease on untreated chronic hepatitis B patients. This research was published in Frontiers in Cellular and Infection Microbiology in 2022. 3. The World Health Organization updated its technical guidance on differentiated and simplified pre-exposure prophylaxis for HIV prevention. This document provides implementation strategies for healthcare providers and was accessed in February 2024. 4. Musabaev E, Estes C, Sadirova S, Bakieva S, Brigida K, Dunn R, and others examine the challenges of eliminating viral hepatitis in lowand middle-income countries, focusing on the Uzbekistan Hepatitis Elimination Programme. Their findings were published in Liver International in 2023. 5. Wang P, Wang X, Liu X, Yan F, Yan H, Zhou D, and colleagues investigate how primary non-response to antiviral therapy affects the prognosis of hepatitis B virus-related hepatocellular carcinoma. Their study appeared in BMC Cancer in 2023. 6. Lin CL, Wu SY, Lai MW, Hsu CW, Chen WM, Jao AT, and others developed a predictive model for assessing the risk of hepatocellular carcinoma in chronic hepatitis B patients undergoing finite periods of antiviral therapy. This research was published in Cancers in 2023. 7. Lee HA, Lee YS, Jung YK, Kim JH, Yim HJ, Yeon JE, and colleagues evaluate the clinical effects of antiviral therapy in patients with hepatitis B virus-related decompensated cirrhosis and undetectable DNA levels. Their findings were published in the Journal of Gastroenterology and Hepatology in 2023. 8. Kim BK and Ahn SH propose a prediction model for hepatitis B virus-related hepatocellular carcinoma in patients receiving antiviral therapy. This study was published in the Journal of the Formosan Medical Association in 2023. 9. Rasool S, Hanif S, Ahmad A, Shafqat U, and Babar AN conducted a prospective follow-up study on the frequency of de novo hepatocellular carcinoma after direct-acting antiviral therapy for chronic hepatitis C. Their findings were published in the Euroasian Journal of Hepato-Gastroenterology in 2022. 10. Lee JH, Shin SK, Kang SH, Kim TH, Yim HJ, Yim SY, and others developed a long-term prediction model for hepatocellular carcinoma in chronic hepatitis B patients receiving antiviral therapy, based on data from Korean patients. This study was published in the Journal of Clinical Medicine in 2022. 11. Chang KC, Lin MT, Wang JH, Hung CH, Chen CH, Chiu SY, and colleagues demonstrate that HBcrAg levels can predict hepatocellular carcinoma development in chronic hepatitis B-related liver cirrhosis patients undergoing long-term effective antiviral therapy. Their research was published in Viruses in 2022. 12. Wong GL, Tse YK, Wong VW, Yip TC, Tsoi KK, and Chan HL conducted a cohort study involving 53,500 subjects to assess the long-term safety of oral nucleos(t)ide analogs for chronic hepatitis B patients. Their findings were published in Hepatology in 2015. 13. Marcellin P, Gane E, Buti M, Afdhal N, Sievert W, Jacobson IM, and others report on the regression of cirrhosis during treatment with tenofovir disoproxil fumarate for chronic hepatitis B in a 5-year open-label follow-up study. This research was published in The Lancet in 2013. 14. Oh JH, Park Y, Goh MJ, Sinn DH, Ahn SB, Kang W, and colleagues demonstrate that improved on-treatment fibrosis-4 scores during antiviral therapy are associated with a lower risk of hepatocellular carcinoma in cirrhotic hepatitis B patients. Their study was published in Scientific Reports in 2023. 15. Huang DQ, Tran A, Yeh ML, Yasuda S, Tsai PC, Huang CF, and others show that antiviral therapy significantly reduces the risk of hepatocellular carcinoma in chronic hepatitis B patients in the indeterminate phase. This research was published in Hepatology in 2023. 16. Hu M, Liao G, Wei S, Qian Z, Chen H, Xia M, and colleagues conducted a multi-center retrospective cohort study analyzing the effectiveness of antiviral treatment in HBeAg-seropositive chronic hepatitis B patients with ALT levels below twice the upper limit of normal. Their findings were published in Infectious Diseases and Therapy in 2023. 17. Cheng PN, Sun HY, Feng IC, Wang ST, Chiu YC, Chiu HC, and others investigated the reversibility of oxidative stress markers in chronic hepatitis C patients after receiving direct-acting antiviral drugs. Their study was published in the Journal of Virus Eradication in 2023. 18. Hsu YC, Yeh ML, Wong GL, Chen CH, Peng CY, Buti M, and colleagues examined the incidence and determinants of functional cure during entecavir or tenofovir disoproxil fumarate treatment for chronic hepatitis B. Their findings were published in the Journal of Infectious Diseases in 2021. 19. Yip TC, Wong GL, Chan HL, Tse YK, Lam KL, Lui GC, and others demonstrate that HBsAg seroclearance further reduces the risk of hepatocellular carcinoma after complete viral suppression with nucleos(t)ide analogs. This study was published in the Journal of Hepatology in 2019. 20. Lim YS, Kim WR, Dieterich D, Kao JH, Flaherty JF, Yee LJ, and others provide evidence supporting the benefits of early treatment initiation for chronic hepatitis B. Their research was published in Viruses in 2023.
